sections.changelog:
### Version 0.1.214
- Add Order Notes Reminder setting to Marketplace Image Generator for variant images
- Render noticeable yet minimal modern frosted glass capsule reminding buyers to mention device model in order notes
- Support flexible capsule positions (under top-right skin name pill, bottom floating, or left column)
- Automatically propagate order note settings across live preview, batch ZIP exports, and Shopee image injector
- Persist order note settings to device profile metadata (_exacoat_marketplace_image_settings) and browser storage
